name: Oil Rig Drill Connector
description: It can connect drill rods together to lengthen them, or separate drill rods to shorten them.
shortDescription: A clamp for moving drill rods into place.

logicNodes.label: Clamp Rod
logicNodes.description: Attach a drill rod to the clamp.

logicNodes.label: Connect/Disconnect
logicNodes.description: Connects or disconnects a pair of drill rods when the ends are aligned at the connection point.

logicNodes.label: Rod Clamped
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a drill rod is attached.

logicNodes.label: Connector Aligned
logicNodes.description: Returns true when the connection point aligns over the end of a pair of drill rods.

logicNodes.label: Slider Velocity
logicNodes.description: Moves an attached drill rod up or down the clamp.
